verdict.rationale: Brex's AI page says its assistants can file reimbursements automatically for employees (brex-docs-23). Its review agent also auto-approves low-risk expenses and requests (brex-docs-16), which implies an employee reimbursement submission and approval flow exists. The evidence never describes the payout itself; the ACH capability shown is vendor bill pay, not employee reimbursement, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: explicit out-of-pocket expense submission flow, direct-deposit reimbursement payout, payout timing in days, submission-to-payout status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration
